text: Android: smaller review findings (stale overview cards, invisible counts, manifest, numbering)

Landed across four commits. Overview expense cards now combine a live expense-items flow with the lists flow, so an added entry refreshes the card; SyncStatus is seeded from the dirty/blocked counts at app start so an offline cold start still shows them; the ledger and the entry form number former members from the same query; the test-only activity ships unexported (needed tools:replace for the debug ui-test-manifest); crash logs moved to their own directory so file_paths.xml no longer grants the whole filesDir; AppVersionResponse decodes protocol (nullable). Deliberately not rewired: the update check still compares version strings, which AGENTS.md's major-release rule makes sound. I corrected the wire contract in 6fbaa02, which had said no client declares the field.
